response.sql:
WITH matched_fees AS (
  SELECT 
    f.orderslink,
    f.rebtotal,
    f.rebrate,
    f.feerate,
    o.ordertune
  FROM fees f
  INNER JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault
),
baseline AS (
  SELECT AVG(rebtotal) as baseline_rebate
  FROM matched_fees
),
group_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    mf.orderslink,
    mf.ordertune,
    AVG(mf.rebtotal) as avg_rebate,
    AVG((mf.rebrate - mf.feerate) / mf.feerate) as avg_gap
  FROM matched_fees mf
  GROUP BY mf.orderslink, mf.ordertune
)
SELECT 
  gs.orderslink,
  gs.ordertune,
  gs.avg_rebate,
  gs.avg_gap,
  gs.avg_rebate - b.baseline_rebate as excess
FROM group_stats gs
CROSS JOIN baseline b
WHERE gs.avg_rebate > b.baseline_rebate
ORDER BY excess DESC
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: feerate is never zero; the query will fail or produce NULL gaps if any fee record has feerate = 0, which the request does not specify how to handle
